{{Main|Equipment}}
'''Sturdy leather armor''' is a stronger leather set crafted from [[Sturdy Leather|sturdy leather]]. It has Projectile Protection, 2 safe fall distance per piece, and the boots add step height and [[Trailblaze]].

== Obtaining ==
The pieces are the [[Sturdy Leather Helmet|helmet]], [[Sturdy Leather Gambeson|gambeson]], [[Sturdy Leather Leggings|leggings]] and [[Sturdy Leather Boots|boots]]. They are repaired with tattered leather.

=== Village tannery chests ===
In 1.12.2, [[village]] tannery chests could hold a piece of sturdy leather armor from an older version of the set, which was invisible when worn and weaker than the crafted pieces. In 1.12.3 the tannery's loot table is empty,<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/village/village_tannery.json}}</ref> and no other table rolls the older pieces, which are still in the pack.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/equipment/sturdy_leather.json}}</ref> [[Shipwreck]] supply chests give the current pieces.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/equipment/sturdy_leather/armour.json}}</ref>
